subject: Close orchestration manifest and escalation: Zephyrus MAP constraints
messages:
From: Amalie Jensen <amalie@zephyrus.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo — draft MAP and timing constraints

Ben,

Thanks for the demo this morning — the team found the latency and routing walkthrough helpful. We're trying to pin a close window for our board (end of November), but the internal evaluation plan (MAP) is slipping on our side because of procurement and a SOC 2 checklist that just popped up.

Attached is our draft MAP (high level) and the procurement timeline we shared internally. Two asks from my side:
- Can Redwood provide a concise risk log we can attach to our board packet?
- If timelines slide, what options exist for a short credit or a limited trial extension while we finish procurement?

I'll loop in procurement separately. Appreciate any clarity we can send to the execs today.

Best,
Amalie Jensen
Head of Platform Partnerships
Zephyrus AI

Attachments: Zephyrus-MAP-draft.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Amalie Jensen <amalie@zephyrus.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Oct 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo — draft MAP and timing constraints

Amalie — great to meet you earlier. Thanks for sending the draft MAP. I pulled together a short orchestration manifest that maps our standard MAP milestones to the items your board typically asks for. Key highlights:

- Proposed firm milestones (owner at Zephyrus / owner at Redwood):
  - Environment kickoff (Zephyrus IT / Redwood onboarding) — target Oct 20
  - Eval run (security & perf) — Oct 27–Nov 7
  - Procurement final approval & PO — Nov 14
  - Production cutover window — Nov 18–22 (target close)

- Risk items we see today: procurement gating (PO timing), SOC 2 evidence request, and a short QA stability window for the shared dataset sampling.

I'm attaching our proposed MAP (redwood-proposed-MAP-v1.pdf) and a short risk log CSV with mitigation options. If procurement needs additional SOC2 evidence we can provide redacted audit logs and our SOC2 scope doc — but that will require a signed NDA/LOA.

For credits/extension: we can offer a 30-day limited trial extension tied to a PO commitment date; I can formalize that if it helps the board. Let me know if you'd like this as a line item in the MAP.

Next step: can we align owners for the procurement milestones? I'll put Grace on the thread to own the risk-log updates.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-proposed-MAP-v1.pdf, close-risk-log.csv
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Amalie Jensen <amalie@zephyrus.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 11 Oct 2025 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo — draft MAP and timing constraints

Amalie — quick note from the risk side. I've started a concise risk ledger focused on the procurement & compliance gates. Highlights below, which I'll keep updated live in the CSV attached:

1) Procurement PO delay
  - Probability: medium
  - Impact: high (blocks go-live)
  - Mitigation: provisional trial extension + conditional credit (requires exec approval)
2) SOC 2 items requested by your InfoSec
  - Probability: high
  - Impact: high (legal/procurement hold)
  - Mitigation: share redacted evidence, schedule a 1-hour walkthrough with our security lead next week
3) Dataset access & privacy checklist
  - Probability: low
  - Impact: medium
  - Mitigation: scoped dataset plan & isolation rules

Amalie — if procurement can give a PO target date range (even tentative), we'll map fallback windows and a possible canary cutover. If you prefer I'll prepare a single-page executive summary of the risk ledger for your board packet.

Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: close-risk-log.csv
From: Amalie Jensen <amalie@zephyrus.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 12 Oct 2025 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo — draft MAP and timing constraints

Thank you both. Procurement asked me to confirm two concrete items:
- A definitive list of SOC 2 artifacts (type + approximate delivery lead time) we can include in the packet.
- Whether Redwood can commit to a bridging arrangement (60% credit if cutover slips past Nov 22 but PO comes within 30 days).

Legal is also asking whether logs and tracing for the eval window can be shared redacted, and if there are any platform isolation guarantees during the trial.

I'll push procurement for a tentative PO range by EOD Monday. If you can put the SOC2 artifact list and a short note on the proposed credit structure together, I can circulate to the board.

Best,
Amalie

Attachments: procurement-constraints.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Amalie Jensen <amalie@zephyrus.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Oct 2025 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo — draft MAP and timing constraints

Amalie / procurement team — following up with an escalation summary for our execs and a formal ask.

Summary: Zephyrus is targeted to close in late Nov but procurement gating and a SOC2 evidence request create high likelihood of slippage. Proposed Redwood response below for immediate board circulation:

1) SOC2 artifacts list (deliverables we can provide within 3 business days once an LOA/NDA is in place):
   - SOC2 scope statement (redacted)
   - Redacted control-mapping summary (covering data access & retention)
   - Sample audit logs (redacted timestamps, user IDs masked)
   - Security architecture diagram and isolation notes

2) Bridging credit proposal (for board):
   - If PO is received within 30 days of Nov 22 but cutover completes after Nov 22, Redwood offers a 45% credit applied to the first month of billed consumption. This is conditioned on a signed commitment letter and clear MAP milestones.
   - We can increase to 60% credit on a case-by-case exec approval; requesting Marissa (cc'd) and Karthik for quick decisioning here.

3) Short-term operational guarantees for the eval window:
   - Redacted logs can be shared under LOA.
   - Environment isolation: dedicated evaluation namespace and ephemeral data mounts for the run.

Request: Marissa / Karthik — would you approve delegation of up to 60% one-time credit authority for this deal subject to PO within 30 days? If yes, I'll fold into a single-page board packet and send to Amalie.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none
